name: Al-Mahmudiya
registryBasis: The official Egyptian General Survey Authority (ESA) describes its historical and current role in producing property/cadastral maps and land records, documents digital-map products in GIS/CAD/PDF/JPG formats, and states that its state-property inventory project includes Beheira Governorate. This establishes relevant official national cadastral custody, but not open parcel-vector integration for Al-Mahmudiya.

queries.query: Egypt official cadastral parcel map service Al Mahmudiyah Beheira GIS Egyptian General Survey Authority
queries.result: Found the official ESA homepage and digital-map service page. ESA identifies cadastral/property-map and digital GIS map work, but no public anonymous Al-Mahmudiya parcel viewer or feature endpoint was exposed.

queries.query: المحمودية البحيرة خريطة كادسترية قطع الأراضي الهيئة المصرية العامة للمساحة
queries.result: Found official ESA references to Beheira cadastral/state-property work and an official notice concerning survey records/maps at the Mahmudiya local unit, but no anonymous parcel-vector response or public Al-Mahmudiya map API.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Egyptian General Survey Authority national cadastral/property-map custody, with documented Beheira coverage and Mahmudiya survey-map procedure context.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Official registry and map-production/procedure context only; anonymous parcel geometry access unverified.

blocker: Bounded verified-TLS GETs to https://www.esa.gov.eg/main.aspx, /sellingmaproomdigital.aspx, /amlak.aspx, /testmap.aspx, /egypt_maps.aspx, /alexDigitalMaps.aspx, and /robots.txt were used to inspect official pages and public route hints. The pages provided institutional/service information and static maps, but no parcel feature service, schema, CRS, or bounded ID+geometry response. No login, CAPTCHA bypass, credentials, private token, unsafe property fields, or TLS-disabling workaround was used.
remainingUncertainty: A staff-mediated ESA/Beheira registry, a non-indexed public viewer, or a separate local GIS service may exist. The unchanged WUP point was not used to infer absence; no exact-point or citywide parcel hit test was possible.
nextStep: A later researcher may retry official ESA/Beheira routes or obtain a documented public service endpoint. Retain only a stable native parcel identity and full geometry after geographic qualification; keep runtime admission held pending independent serial review.
